title: Lorem
description: Case notes on the Lorem studio site — Time Coils album viewer, zero-CLS plate swapping and a CMS-owned archive the studio runs themselves
summary: Parts catalogue with instant client-side search over a prebuilt static JSON index
notes: Art direction follows the studio’s book-catalogue identity — near-black stage, one grotesk at book sizes and the album plates left to carry all the colour, mapped to three custom properties and nothing else on the page

The album viewer swaps plates from scroll position — a fixed stage cross-fading artwork at 0,35× scroll speed while the corner metadata rails stay static, so the layout never reflows and CLS sits at a hard zero

Archive and About reuse the row pattern from the rest of the site — number, title and medium in one narrow column with a single hairline rule, twenty-odd entries as rows instead of thumbnails so the index stays scannable on a phone

items: plate metadata — title, medium, year — as typed records
grotesk text face with tabular numerals for the year rail

notes: Plate loading runs through one intersection queue — full-res AVIF decoded once, blurred LQIP underneath and the prev/next thumbnails preloaded exactly one step ahead, so the arrows never stutter between frames
The studio keeps the archive current on their own — new plates and project rows land through the CMS weekly, and the design layer has not needed a single touch since handover
